description: This file defines a custom Observable class that manages a list of observers, allowing them to be notified of changes. It improves concurrency, prevents subclassing, and modifies visibility of certain methods compared to java.util.Observable.

classes.name: Observable
classes.description: A thread-safe, non-subclassable observable object that manages observers and notifies them of changes.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the list of observers.

methods.name: clearChanged
methods.description: Resets the changed flag to false.

methods.name: deleteObserver
methods.description: Removes a specific observer from the list.

methods.name: deleteObservers
methods.description: Removes all observers from the list.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the observable has been marked as changed.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all observers with a null argument.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all observers with a specified argument.
